text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And with that, let the Umadol Concert
Meeting
begin! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Now requesting meeting
agenda
data.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what... How did I get caught up in
this?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
On today's agenda is... discussing
interactive
performances for the fans!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
After all, the best part of concerts is
when you
feel a strong connection with
everyone there. ☆

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Searching memory for activities involving
strong
connections... Match found. How
about forming a
human pyramid?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I don't think that's what we're talking
about... It's
a little too acrobatic.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we're Umadols, not the circus.
Maybe we
could have the audience clap
along or have them
sing the chorus!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Then why don't we have the
audience
clap, and we could perform
backflips and
somersaults in time with
their claps?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, why don't we move away from
acrobatics...
